These Terms of Use (“Terms”) govern access to and use of the iSupport-D website, mobile application, and related digital services (“Platform”).
By accessing or using the Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms.
If you do not agree, you must not use the Platform.
These Terms should be read together with the iSupport-D Privacy Notice and any Research Participant Information and Consent documentation provided to you.

The Platform provides educational information, self-support tools, and research-related content for people supporting individuals living with dementia.
The Platform is not a clinical service, crisis service, or substitute for professional medical, psychological, legal, or aged-care advice.
Users must seek advice from appropriately qualified professionals regarding individual circumstances.

You must:
Be at least 18 years old (or have consent from a parent/guardian where permitted by law)
Provide accurate and complete information when creating an account
Use the Platform only for lawful purposes
We may suspend or terminate access where eligibility requirements are not met.
3.2 Research and Program Information

If you participate in research components, we may collect:
Responses to questionnaires, surveys, or program activities
Feedback on usability and acceptability
Wellbeing, caregiving, or dementia-related experiences
Other health or sensitive information relevant to approved research aims
Sensitive information will only be collected with explicit informed consent and in accordance with ethics approval.
3.3 Automatically Collected Data

When using the Platform, technical data may be collected automatically, including:
IP address
Device identifiers
Browser type and operating system
Usage patterns and session duration
Navigation paths and feature engagement
This data supports system security, analytics, service optimisation and research evaluation.
Data Breach Response & Notification Clause (Platform + Governance Document)

Users are responsible for:
Maintaining the confidentiality of login credentials
All activities conducted under their account
Promptly notifying the research team of suspected unauthorised use
We may implement authentication, monitoring, and security controls to protect users and system integrity.

You agree not to:
Use the Platform in a way that breaches any law or regulation
Upload or transmit harmful, offensive, misleading, or unlawful content
Attempt to interfere with Platform functionality or security
Attempt to access other users’ data without authorisation
Use automated tools to extract or scrape data
Use the Platform for commercial marketing or solicitation
We reserve the right to moderate, restrict, or remove access where misuse is suspected.

Some Platform features form part of approved research studies.
Participation is voluntary and may involve:
Completing questionnaires or feedback tools
Allowing analysis of usage patterns
Contributing to program evaluation
Users may withdraw from research participation at any time, subject to research protocol requirements.
Withdrawal will not affect access to general educational content unless continued access would compromise research integrity.

The Platform may use analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled tools to personalise user experience and improve program delivery.
These tools:
Are designed for educational and research purposes
Do not provide clinical diagnosis or treatment recommendations
Should not be relied upon as the sole basis for decision-making

All Platform content, including text, graphics, videos, software, and program materials, is owned by or licensed to the iSupport-D research team or affiliated institutions.
Users may:
Access and use content for personal, non-commercial purposes
Users must not:
Reproduce, distribute, modify, or commercially exploit Platform content without written permission

We aim to maintain Platform availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free access.
We may:
Update, modify, suspend, or discontinue features
Restrict access for maintenance or security reasons
Where possible, reasonable notice will be provided.

The Platform may include links to external websites or services.
We do not control and are not responsible for third-party content, privacy practices, or availability.
Access to third-party services is at the user’s own risk.

To the maximum extent permitted by law:
Platform content is provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis
We make no warranties regarding accuracy, completeness, reliability, or suitability
The Platform is not intended to address emergencies or urgent care needs
Users should seek professional advice before acting on information obtained through the Platform.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, the iSupport-D research team, participating institutions, funders, and personnel are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential loss or damage arising from:
Use of or reliance on Platform content
Technical failures or service interruptions
Unauthorised access to user data beyond our reasonable control
User decisions relating to caregiving or health management
Nothing in these Terms excludes rights that cannot be excluded under applicable consumer or privacy legislation.
Users agree to indemnify and hold harmless the research team and affiliated institutions from claims, losses, or damages arising from misuse of the Platform or breach of these Terms.

We may suspend or terminate access where:
These Terms are breached
Required by law or ethics obligations
Necessary to protect users, research integrity, or system security
Users may stop using the Platform at any time.
These Terms are governed by the laws of Australia, and users submit to the jurisdiction of Australian courts, unless mandatory laws in another country apply.
